sql: select 'live' as src, strategy, status, count(*) as n, sum(quantity) as qty, min(created_at) as first, max(created_at) as last from live_orders where strategy in ('Nmmsell10','Kmmsell10') and created_at >= '2026-10-16 14:11:00' group by strategy, status union all select 'paper', strategy, status, count(*), sum(quantity), min(created_at), max(created_at) from paper_trades where strategy in ('Nmmsell10_pt4','Pmmsell10') and created_at >= '2026-10-16 09:00:00' group by strategy, status order by 1,2,3
